channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: More Buckets
item.description: Leave the exhausting trips to the spring behind and let the new buckets do the hard work

item.title: Boat Speed Tweaks
item.description: Multiply Sailboats and Rafts speed by the configured factor, separately (default for both = 2.0)

item.title: Better forest
item.description: Improved forest and tree generation. No new blocks. No impact on performance. Only server side.

item.title: GG Server Patch
item.description: Some extra recipes and/or content for the server

item.title: Panning Machine
item.description: Simple machine for panning

item.title: Atlas
item.description: Integration testing for mods: xUnit scenarios against a real headless server, in your IDE and CI

item.title: Muppers Arcana
item.description: A book-learned magic mod: find spellbooks in ruins and from traders and learn powers.

item.title: NDL Villagers
item.description: Adds Villagers/Guards/Clerics to populate your builds and also a way to get traders in your builds!

item.title: Yang's Transport Tycoon
item.description: Construct and operate industrial transport machinery.

item.title: Just Poop It
item.description: Everything poops... now your character does too.

item.title: Integrated Mod Manager
item.description: Configure your mods, fetch dependencies, and resolve conflicts entirely in-game!

item.title: Distant Vistas
item.description: Personal singleplayer far LOD. Vintage Horizons fork. Farseer no longer shuts this off. Run with Cli

item.title: Animalica - Compatibility Pack 3 (Dinosaurs)
item.description: Adds clothing-capable playable dinosaurs and marine reptiles from Legacy of the Phanerozoic modules

item.title: Animalica - Compatibility pack 2: (FotSA)
item.description: Adds clothing-capable playable models for six Fauna of the Stone Age modules

item.title: Animalica - Compatibility pack 1
item.description: Adds a small list of modded animals as players!

item.title: Animalica - Hooved Animals
item.description: Adds all the hooved animals as playable models!

item.title: Animalica - Small & Odd
item.description: Adds the small goober animals like raccoons, chickens, and rabbits as players

item.title: Animalica - Bears
item.description: Adds Bears as player choices

item.title: Animalica - Foxes, Wolves & Hyenas
item.description: Adds Foxes, Wolves, and Hyenas as player choices!

item.title: Riley's RP Additions
item.description: This is a mod that uses Quivers and Sheaths to add some RP-related items!

item.title: Saltpeter Production Fork
item.description: Saltpeter Production compatibility update for version 1.22.x

item.title: moontweaks
item.description: Server-side Lua scripting! Add mod compat & make new recipes with ease.

item.title: RunicMagic
item.description: Discover a world specific runic language, research its words, and write your own spells.

item.title: Simple teleporter
item.description: Teleport to your home or any marked location on your map.

item.title: Frontier Claims Map
item.description: Claim map and access controls for internal testing on a private server.

item.title: Low Light Spawns
item.description: Simple mod to change the light level at which all monsters spawn

item.title: WorldEngine for VS Toolkit
item.description: A planet-based world generation pipeline.

item.title: Heatproof Bricks
item.description: Firebricks handle heat damage better, and tier 3 doesn't break anymore!

item.title: No Waste Bloomery
item.description: Makes the bloomery drop all the materials used to craft it.

item.title: Waywheel
item.description: A modular radial-menu framework for quick access to tools and gear with built-in backpack support!
